title: TCP: fix duplication detection count and table display
description:
tcp.analysis.duplication_count now reflects the final total number of
     times a segment was seen across the entire capture rather than the
     incremental count at the time each frame was first dissected (having
     the incremental was confusing, and found to be useless). This
     means the original frame and all its duplicates show the cumulative
     value.

     The duplication table now shows all packets in the stream, including
     those seen only once (count=1), rather than only packets with
     duplicates. This allows for a fluid click through, and a valid view for
     when only 2 capture points are in the path.

     AI-Assisted: yes
